evidence_families.independence_boundary: The exact blob was reexecuted in a separate local sandbox with dummy data and injected transport, but it shares project code and is mechanism reexecution, not independent provider or target-host replication.

evidence_families.direct_result: Four distinct effective request targets at the same origin passed the current pre-network gate and collapsed to one request_id because identity binds hostname but not path, query, fragment or resolved selector.
critical_qualification: The injected response deliberately returned success; no claim is made that NVIDIA accepts, charges for or semantically interprets the alternate targets.
The counterexample proves local admission and identity aliasing only.
Origin binding still prevents cross-origin bearer-token exfiltration in these fixtures; the remaining risk is endpoint/capability/cost-scope confusion within one origin.

interpretation: The supervisor successfully consumed the prior cost-principal and payment-latch impulse, but its committed evidence snapshot is already stale relative to the currently observed PR head.
Later exact-head inspection shows the 402 and identity blockers survive, so the decision happens to remain substantively correct.
That later revalidation is separate evidence; the supervisor receipt itself does not prove the blockers against the new bytes.
evidence_families.timestamp_boundary: API commit timestamps are consistent with a fetch-to-write race, but timestamps alone do not prove the exact read ordering or availability moment. The durable claim is the observed head/workflow mismatch.

sources.claim: HTTP(S) userinfo is deprecated; a recipient should parse for it and treat its presence from an untrusted source as an error.
Python exposes parsed username, password, hostname and port separately, supporting the implemented userinfo check; percent-encoded sequences are not decoded by urlparse.
NVIDIA documents the hosted LLM URL as integrate.api.nvidia.com and the exact chat operation as POST /v1/chat/completions.
GitHub workflow-run queries and objects bind runs to an exact head_sha; run evidence must therefore not be silently transferred to another PR head.
GitHub reference updates support non-forced fast-forward behavior and conflict responses, providing a control-plane analogy for compare-and-set writes.

concepts.hypothesis: FREE_ONLY authorization must bind a normalized exact request-target capability <scheme, host, effective port, canonical base path and operation template, absent userinfo/query/fragment, provider, model/product, entitlement evidence version, cost principal and budget epoch>; origin equality alone is insufficient.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Origin-level binding is sufficient because alternate same-origin paths merely fail and provider billing/account policy is origin-wide.
concepts.synthesis: Preserve strict origin binding, then require the production target to equal a provider-owned operation template. Same-origin path variation is denied unless a separately typed capability and cost policy authorizes it.
decisive_tests: Require canonical NVIDIA production base path exactly /v1, empty params/query/fragment and resolved selector exactly /v1/chat/completions before constructing the authenticated request.
Run alternate path, dot-segment, percent-encoding, query and fragment fixtures; every unauthorized target must stop before the injected opener.
Bind normalized endpoint capability identity into semantic request, cost-authority and execution-lineage receipts.
Hold body/provider constant while varying authorized endpoint identity; semantic content may match, but execution lineage and request-target receipt must not alias.

concepts.hypothesis: Every supervisor decision must bind one coherent evidence cut containing canonical base head, exact candidate PR heads/blobs, exact workflow head_sha/run IDs and source-check timestamps; all mutable heads must be re-read immediately before write, and any change forces STALE_INPUT_RETRY or explicit supersession.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Monotonic safety blockers can be propagated across head changes without re-reading because additional commits cannot invalidate the conservative denial.
concepts.synthesis: A denial may remain operationally fail-closed, but it must be labelled STALE_INPUT until the blocker is revalidated on the new exact bytes. No acceptance, blocker closure or capability credit may cross a head change.
decisive_tests: Inject a PR-head advance between supervisor evidence fetch and canonical write; require compare-and-set failure or a STALE_INPUT_RETRY receipt.
Repeat with a commit that repairs the blocker and one that leaves it unchanged; both require exact-head revalidation, while only the latter may supersede the old blocker as still-open.
Hash <canonical parent, PR head, source blobs, workflow head_sha/run IDs, checked_at> into evidence_cut_id and persist supersedes edges in UnifiedDB/ClayGraph.
Reject any green or failed workflow whose recorded head_sha differs from the candidate bytes being adjudicated.
